about.title: Technical profile, data
paragraphs: I am a Computer Engineer and Data Analyst at SDG Group, working with data transformation, quality and analytical processes.
My Software Engineering background comes from Occident, where I worked on corporate applications, backend and AI-related processes.
I combine this technical foundation with Data Science and AI to connect reliable data with business questions.
focusAreas: Data Science and AI with statistical judgment
